items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A guy named Bumps Blackwell did it. ... So I put it up to this guy, and he said sure, no problem. So this was my first effort, to get Jimmy Rowles with four horns and do an album.

ctx.x: We‟ll jump ahead and talk about In a Jazz Orbit. I‟m sorry.

Where was I? They didn‟t have a producer to run our dates. A guy named Bumps Blackwell did it. He was very big in the pop scene. He got in there, and you could tell from what he was saying over the talker that he didn‟t know much about what we were doing. So I said, these guys, if they‟re going to do jazz records, they‟re going to need a jazz producer. So why don‟t I do it? So I put it up to this guy, and he said sure, no problem. So this was my first effort, to get Jimmy Rowles with four horns and do an album.…
Let‟s see which one they give him credit for on here. He‟s credited with Throwin‟ Stones at the Sun, maybe. This is the only one that‟s got multiple takes. They don‟t credit which tune he sang on.
